h1: What can you build on a pre-existing nonconforming lot or home in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Nonconforming Lots and Homes: Additions, Alterations and Zoning Relief
description: Understand why an existing nonconforming property needs a review under Massachusetts law and Newton's zoning ordinance before changes are made.
short_answer: An existing nonconforming lot or structure does not automatically make every future addition or alteration permissible. Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 40A, Section 6 and Newton Zoning Ordinance Section 7.8 govern nonconforming situations. The result depends on the property's legal history and the proposed change, so obtain a parcel-specific determination before designing the project.

facts.text: Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 40A, Section 6 addresses nonconforming lots, structures, and uses and the conditions under which zoning changes may apply.
Newton's Zoning Ordinance contains a separate section addressing nonconforming lots, buildings, structures, and uses.

qa.q: Can I enlarge a home that already violates a setback?
qa.a: Do not assume the existing condition allows an addition. Newton must evaluate the proposed change under state law and its local nonconforming-structure rules.
